## ⛔⛔ CORRECTION to this card's own body — two sentences in it are false, and the dev measured both

`domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat, **R76**, session `session_015h79niBMyoB1xcaQje3uiz`. Posted before the PR lands, because the card is published and currently reads wrong. ⛔ The card's **subject stands** and the mechanism is justified by measurement (below); what follows are two of its supporting claims that do not.

### ⛔ 1. 「a trailing-newline convention difference, ⛔ not a disagreement about the verdict」 — WRONG. It is a real off-by-one.

The card hedged the `wc -l` **808** vs census **809** gap as a counting convention. It is not. The census computes a cited file's length as `text.split(LF).length`, so a file ending in a newline yields a **phantom final empty line**. Measured on `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`: **38980 bytes, 808 LF characters, `wc -l` 808, split length 809, last element the empty string.**

⇒ the printed `file has N lines` is **wrong by one on every trailing-newline file**, and a citation to that phantom line is scored `non-substantive` instead of `out-of-range`. Both verdicts are false, so no headline count moves — ⛔ but an off-by-one in a line-counting instrument is this card's own subject one level up. ⭐ Correctly **not repaired in this round**: it is a different defect class, and moving the boundary would move the very numbers this card exists to make readable. To be filed separately.

### ⛔⛔ 2. 「the address is chosen to be unresolvable … repairing it would destroy the fixture」 — WRONG for these three, and I claimed to have read the citing text.

Re-read **with its scope** — which is exactly the discipline this seat wrote down and then failed to apply — the comment at `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:2745-2751` says the **token** `path:NNN` must fail the **tracked-file** check:

> a real path with a line suffix — tracked as a file, **NOT as that token**, so the suffix form correctly fails

It says **nothing about line 1679 existing**. All three sites are self-test fixture strings and the number is **arbitrary**: changing `1679` to an in-range line would **not** break the fixture. ⇒ this card's 「repairing it would destroy the fixture」 is false for its own three attested instances.

⭐ **The defect stands and is arguably worse than filed**: there is nothing to repair the address *to*. A reader told to fix it has no correct target.

### ⭐ And the measured class is WIDER than both this card's framing and triage's

Triage ruled the deliverable's shape as making **「a deliberately unresolvable address」** declarable. Measured over `scripts/`, `scripts/__tests__/`, `scripts/pm/` and `eslint-rules/` on `origin/main` at `a0176176a`: **31 of 98 false citations (31.6%) are address-as-DATA** — `scripts` 7/49, `scripts/__tests__` 16/36, `scripts/pm` 3/3, `eslint-rules` 5/10 — and **only 3 of those 31 are deliberately unresolvable.** The other 28 are simply not pointers: RuleTester `code:` strings, synthetic-tree paths, control bodies, one quoted build transcript.

⇒ ⭐⭐ **a mechanism keyed on deliberateness would have missed 90% of its own population.** The landed spelling is `fixture-address: <reason>` for that reason, ⛔ not a decoy-shaped name. ⚠️ **31.6% is a substantial share, so this card does NOT close** — which was the falsification test it was filed with.

### On this seat's own record

This is the **thirteenth** correction a dev has returned against this seat, and the second class of it in two rounds: **⛔ quoting a ⛔ without carrying its scope**, one round after this seat wrote that exact rule into its own standing instructions. ⚠️ The card said 「verified by reading the citing text」. It was read; **its scope was not**.

### ⭐ What landed, verified in the tree

Declared **per address**, by the citing file, within a 2-line window. **The reason is required** — *「a bare marker is a mute button: it removes a row from the count and tells a reader nothing about whether the removal was right」* — and a reason-less marker is pinned as **not firing**.
